plain: Clas Svahn, a Swedish researcher who collects UFO reports, says there is a place called Mattibu on Gotland, an island in Sweden, where people go to a certain stretch of road at night. According to Svahn, they go there to watch for lights that come wandering along the road, which makes it a local spot where the strange lights are said to keep returning.
